compound indicating the beginning period of three days

items.question: What offering procedure is prescribed on the third day and from the three-day period onward?
premises: On the third day a specific offering is to be given.
From the beginning of the three-day period an offering is prescribed.
This prescription is regarded as the established rule.
items.inference: The accepted procedure requires giving five offerings on the third day and following the rule from the three-day period onward.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the five offerings is not specified in this verse alone.
The repetition of vidhiḥ may be emphatic or textual, but its precise force is unclear.
items.plain_english: On the third day one should give five; from the start of the three-day period this is considered the proper procedure.
